newsitem.title: UAE: Second Iran quake causes no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Second Iran quake causes no casualties.

text.p: A second earthquake in Iran that hit the cities of Ardabil and Nir in the northwest of the country on Monday did not cause any casualties or damage, an Iranian official said.
Behruz Qorbani, head of the natural disasters headquarters in Ardabil, told the official news agency IRNA the 4.8 force earthquake "did not cause any loss of life or damage".
IRNA was monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.
The quake struck two days after a 7.1 force quake devastated the country's eastern region killing nearly 2,400 people, displacing 50,000 and leaving 200 villages in ruins.
Many tremors with magnitude of more than four have hit Ardabil since February 28 when an earthquake with an intensity of 5.5 jolted the region, killing about 1,000 people and injuring at least 2,600.
